software_new.DESCRIPTION: Viam: robot software platform presented as a harness for AI agents to develop, deploy and operate robot applications on mixed hardware; the open-source viam-server runs on the robot and enforces limits, and outside agents connect through the Viam MCP server.

X Square Robot's vision-language-action foundation model (2026-11-23), built from a Qwen3.5 base, with Lite (4B) and Nano (2B) variants; the company reports 55.1% zero-shot success across 312 evaluator-chosen tasks on physical robots. Licence and model weights are not stated in the announcement.

Anticipatory Humanoid Dance from Streaming Audio (UCL Humanoid Robotics Lab): generates targets for a Unitree G1's 29 joints 30 times a second from live audio, shown on the real robot with eight songs in seven styles (arXiv 2611.13370; code announced, not yet released).

What Matters in Dexterous Play Pretraining for Precise Assembly? Two-stage reinforcement learning: free play with diverse objects in simulation, then fine-tuning for contact-rich precise assembly with multi-fingered hands, transferred zero-shot to real hardware (CoRL 2026; arXiv 2606.26428; code on GitHub).

datasets_new.NAME: AXIS Skills Atlas
datasets_new.DESCRIPTION: AXIS Robotics catalogue of 11,199 robot tasks (unique task IDs, snapshot 2026-11-06), each a LeRobot-format dataset, filterable by skill and robot and exportable as CSV; it links to 14.6 TB of public simulation data on Hugging Face (2026-11-10).
datasets_new.EMBODIMENT: Six main robot embodiments, including Franka arms; ALOHA kept as a historical record
datasets_new.CAPTURE_METHOD: Simulation (public data); per-task capture not stated
datasets_new.DATA_FORMAT: LeRobot v3.0 (Parquet + MP4), 15 fps, two 640x360 RGB cameras
datasets_new.LICENSE_NOTE: Licence not stated on the atlas; check each Hugging Face dataset card
datasets_new.VERSION_SCOPE: Task-list snapshot 2026-11-06; public simulation data 2026-11-10; page checked 2026-11-25
datasets_new.KEY_TAKEAWAY: A task catalogue over many LeRobot datasets, not one corpus: 11,199 counts task IDs, not data volume.
datasets_new.SOURCE_LOCATOR: Task explorer; Data section; source note
datasets_new.REVIEW_STATUS: Primary source overview checked; no independent data replication
datasets_new.LIMITATIONS: Task IDs, not hours or episodes. 8,925 is the PICK-tag count, not the total. 392 robot labels are model-inferred. Some source links may need AXIS Hub access. 14.6 TB is storage size, not comparable with hours.

datasets_new.DESCRIPTION: Physical AI data company that records human work in factories, warehouses, farms and homes with its own capture devices and turns it into labelled training datasets (sight, sound, motion and touch) for robotics and world-model developers.
datasets_new.EMBODIMENT: Human work in factories, warehouses, farms and homes
datasets_new.CAPTURE_METHOD: Proprietary capture devices; provider-operated collection in 20+ countries
datasets_new.LICENSE_NOTE: Dataset licence not established; commercial terms
datasets_new.VERSION_SCOPE: Source snapshot 2026-11-25; no public release pinned
datasets_new.KEY_TAKEAWAY: A commercial data supply service, not a fixed public dataset.
datasets_new.REVIEW_STATUS: Primary source overview checked; no independent data replication
datasets_new.LIMITATIONS: No public corpus, volume, sensor specification or named customer. Revenue and scale figures are company claims. Modalities are as the company names them (sight, sound, motion, touch).
